evidence.t: Unnamed lake, 17.6 ha, 90 m from the road.
About 6 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside South Nanaimo River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 261 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: South Nanaimo River. Closed September 1 to December 31. Synopsis map 3-2/23.
Private land 90 m N: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

plan: Drive: from District of North Cowichan, about 52 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Richards Trail, Westholme Rd, Hwy 1 (Trans-Canada Hwy), Nanaimo River Rd.
Park: 49.06053, -124.12614, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 110 m SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 5 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-5, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R1B-duck-drive-0001.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 1-5: about 13,636 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 3.89 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 5 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
